profile.org_note: No regional layer is public: the company runs by market (Houston, San Antonio, Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, Nashville, Huntsville, Arizona) under CEO Lance Wright, who runs operations, and Senior EVP Kirk Breitenwischer, who by the company's own description runs land analysis, due diligence, land and lot contract negotiation and closings; both are minority owners. Finance sits with a CFO (Bruce Torkelson per third-party directories) and, above CastleRock, with Daiwa House USA Holdings Inc. in Irving, TX (President Yoichi Shimoyama, Secretary/CFO Atsuo Suzuki), which owns 89.11% through CRC Holdings LLC, a holding company Daiwa House set up on 2025-12-01 specifically to facilitate financing for CastleRock. The market rows under regions are markets, not confirmed formal divisions; the only division head found is Dallas-Fort Worth, from a third-party directory. The careers page still uses the older name CastleRock Communities L.P.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @c-rock.com (for example jsmith@c-rock.com), with a few exceptions
profile.summary: Houston-based entry-level and move-up builder founded in 2004, majority owned by Japan's Daiwa House since September 2021 (an 80% stake at the time, per trade press; 89.11% as of December 2025, per Daiwa House). Daiwa House reported 1,465 homes delivered, USD 645 million of sales and 268 employees for FY2024. It builds in four Texas metros plus Arizona (2023), Nashville (2024 acquisition) and Huntsville (October 2025 acquisition), and describes itself as a lot developer as well as a builder. Growth is funded by the parent, which reorganised ownership under CRC Holdings LLC in December 2025 to make financing easier.
